question: At fixed physical facts and exactly balanced 1 or 8 observed factual exposures PER DISTINCT world, does a readout-head-gradient cap preserve backbone gradient updates and reproducibly improve true heldout factual-return regression compared with the identical original hard core and a conventional GRU, when world diversity is 256 vs 16? Preserve separate full-width (1024) high-first baseline with 1 exposure/world.
null: A tiny/synthetic TEST-only factual-return MSE gain is not policy value learning, transfer to novel laws, native independent scientific qualification, official CUDA fused Mamba2+TTT, or permission to promote. If both frozen independent seeds do not satisfy EVERY 32w/256world/8exposure criterion, record R93_EXPOSURE_HEADCAP_DEV_NO_GO regardless of favorable later post hoc levels. If resource limit interrupts mandatory levels or source invalid, status R93_INCOMPLETE_RESOURCE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO.
hypothesis: R92 showed full native selected-return training often worsens after globally clipping a >80-120 norm head gradient and only 0.75 sampled exposures per world. Direct readout-head cap at pre-global gradient norm1, with exact balanced eight action-return exposures/world, should improve independent TEST-only factual-return MSE without leakage compared to globally clipped original hard native; if not, evidence points away from this isolated optimizer adjustment.

source.dev_indices: 1000..1063, independent panel salt, NEVER used in training or checkpoint choice
source.world_generator: r85._make_synthetic_world(index % r85.N, numpy Generator(SeedSequence([new_panel_salt,seed,index]))) ONLY, not r89._world/r89._test_world/r91 scored panels
source.view: r89._view exact factual chosen physical 9-tick return, r88._public_slots returns four actually observed A response rows in role order plus selected factual pivot action row
source.chosen_action_rule: CALIBRATE when (seed+index) parity even else EXPLOIT_POS; one physical chosen action and one observed return per independent world, no counterfactual payoff or private law trained
source.heldout: DEV_TEST 64 fresh separate worlds per seed may be constructed ONLY ONCE AFTER EVERY FROZEN ARM/LEVEL FINISHES, NO scoring, training, early stopping, hyperparameter tuning or rerun on already scored DEV_TEST

design.order: HIGHEST_WIDTH_1024_WORLDS256_ONE_EXPOSURE_PER_WORLD_FIRST, then width32 worlds256/eight exposures, worlds256/one exposure, worlds16/eight exposures, worlds16/one exposure
design.native_reference: R74 original HybridPilot_FULL original hard depth router, R75 triangular native reference TTT, original same-seed initial tensors, same 5 legal original observed event rows per model
design.headcap: After backward and BEFORE the original global 1.0 clip, apply independent L2 norm cap 1.0 to head parameters only; then apply original global 1.0 to all. No other changes to optimizer/model; train via factual-return MSE only.
design.no_depth: Ablation deletes depth module but retains original other same-seeded native weights; different model parameter count; no formal compute match.
design.GRU64: R81 original GRU64 receives same lawful 5 event rows, identical model architecture for shuffled negative; no extra training budget, matched training records and per-world factual exposure across all arms.
design.shuffled_negative: Replace true 4 observed A event rows with other independent train-world A rows inside early/cold pivot stratum; retain own chosen factual action and exact role/time observation geometry; shuffle deterministically independent of truth.

training.balanced_deterministic_epochs: For each epoch, each of the n training worlds appears exactly once; repeat e independent seeded full permutations; per-arm for a given seed/level reuses identical ordered minibatches and factual selected-return labels
training.first_group_gradients: Record first-batch head vs all non-head norm BEFORE head cap, pre-global total norm, headclip activation, global clip activation, and initial stem/router/TTT gradients; report head share of final clipped gradient
training.per_arm_metrics: Full TRAIN before and after factual-return MSE, fresh DEV_TEST factual-return MSE, model params, updates, true per-world exposures, full train-loop wall time, numeric finiteness, head clip fraction/global clip fraction
training.memory: Only ephemeral in-RAM state_dict needed for heldout readback; no external model weights or persistent checkpoints

frozen_evaluation.compare_and_report: Gains are (baseline_mse - candidate_mse) / max(abs(baseline_mse),epsilon). Neither constant from DEV mean nor oracle action payoffs trained. Additional width1024/256/1 and width32/16 and 1-exposure comparisons descriptive only, no post hoc successes.
